model:
package examples.order {

class Event {
  t:Real
}

class Scheduler {
  power_on:Event
  pick_boot_image:Event
  establish_clock:Event
  boot:Event
  evr_service_start:Event
  init_evr:Event
  power_on_star_sensor:Event
  mount_flash:Event
  power_on_navigation:Event
  power_off_cameras:Event

  req power_on.t < power_off_cameras.t

  req power_off_cameras.t < pick_boot_image.t

  req pick_boot_image.t < boot.t

  req pick_boot_image.t < power_on_star_sensor.t

  req boot.t < establish_clock.t

  req power_on_star_sensor.t < establish_clock.t

  req establish_clock.t < init_evr.t

  req init_evr.t < evr_service_start.t

  req establish_clock.t < mount_flash.t

  req mount_flash.t < power_on_navigation.t
}


}

; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Event (mk-Event (t Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Scheduler (mk-Scheduler (power_on Ref)(pick_boot_image Ref)(establish_clock Ref)(boot Ref)(evr_service_start Ref)(init_evr Ref)(power_on_star_sensor Ref)(mount_flash Ref)(power_on_navigation Ref)(power_off_cameras Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  (lift-Scheduler (sel-Scheduler Scheduler))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Event ((this Ref)) Event
  (sel-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Scheduler ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Scheduler (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Scheduler ((this Ref)) Scheduler
  (sel-Scheduler (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Event this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Scheduler ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Scheduler this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Event:

; --- getters for Event.t: ---

(define-fun Event.t ((this Ref)) Real

)

; --- getters for Scheduler.establish_clock: ---

; --- getters for Scheduler.boot: ---

; --- getters for Scheduler.evr_service_start: ---
